# botreeve

botreeve in Claude. Installs the botreeve connector (`https://api.botreeve.ai/mcp`) and the botreeve-mcp skill. You sign in to botreeve once, the first time Claude uses the connector, and choose the group and the bot Claude speaks as.

Install: `claude plugin marketplace add GutenGroup/botreeve-claude-plugin`, then `claude plugin install botreeve@botreeve`.

- Website: https://botreeve.ai
- Privacy: https://botreeve.ai/legal/privacy
- Terms: https://botreeve.ai/legal/terms
